# Release list

<!-- Generated by @internal/docs (target: release-list). Run `yarn fix` to update. -->

`tallyrelease run --github-output` writes `releases` to `$GITHUB_OUTPUT`: a compact JSON array of everything to publish. The JSON schema is exported as `@tallyrelease/cli/releases.schema.json`.

- Releases and cut prereleases come first, oldest release commit first, then in plan unit order.
- Build prereleases follow in plan unit order. A unit released or cut at HEAD has no build prerelease entry.
- Every stable tag in the range is listed, also several of one unit, so nothing tagged stays unpublished. A failed run lists its releases again on the next run.
- Within a major, entries only gain fields.

| Field           | Type                           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| --------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`            | string                         | Unit id.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `path`          | string                         | Unit root.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `kind`          | `"release"` or `"prerelease"`  | `release` for a stable release, `prerelease` for a build or cut prerelease.                                                                                                                                                    |
| `version`       | string                         | Released version, or the prerelease version of the plan.                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `channel`       | string or null                 | Build, nightly or cut channel of a prerelease, null for a release.                                                                                                                                                             |
| `tag`           | string or null                 | Version tag of a release or cut prerelease, null for a build prerelease.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `releaseSha`    | string                         | Full sha of the tagged commit, or HEAD for a build prerelease.                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `catchUp`       | boolean                        | True when not built from HEAD by this run: the release commit is not HEAD, or the unit is outside the build set.                                                                                                               |
| `forge`         | object or null                 | PR and forge release looked up on the forge, null for a build prerelease or without a forge.                                                                                                                                   |
| `forge.pr`      | object or null                 | PR that merged the release commit, else null.                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `forge.release` | object or null                 | Forge release of the tag, else null. Null also for a release that a dry run would create.                                                                                                                                      |
| `latest`        | boolean                        | True for the unit's highest stable tag, never on a maintenance line; false for prereleases.                                                                                                                                    |
| `changes`       | list of object                 | Changes in the shape of the plan's `units[].changes`: the unit's own, then those of the units it was propagated from (transitively), with `via` naming the owning unit. For a prerelease, those since the last stable release. |
| `tags`          | list of string                 | Sorted unit tags.                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `group`         | string or null                 | Fixed group of the unit, else null.                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `line`          | `"default"` or `"maintenance"` | Line of the planned branch.                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `buildNumber`   | integer or null                | First-parent commit count of `releaseSha` plus the unit's `buildNumber.offset`, null for a unit without `buildNumber`. Not part of the version.                                                                                |
